params.name: file_id
params.description: Include only resources from a given file identified by its ID

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort direction for the traces. Defaults to descending order of timestamp.

params.name: start
params.description: Start date of the time window (earliest time)

params.name: end
params.description: End date of the time window (latest time)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum items to return in each paginated response

params.name: order_by
params.description: When set to end_time, traces are sorted by their end time, and pending traces are omitted. When set to start_time, all traces are included, with pending traces given "0" for their end time.

items.docs: Get OpenTelemetry traces within a specified time window with flexible pagination options: Pass in only the end time to paginate backwards from there. Pass in a start time to paginate backwards from now until the start time. Pass in both to get resources within the time window. Choose to return in end_time order instead to view traces that completed in a window or since a time. Filter additionally by branch_ids or file_id.
